cohort: 188,809 deliveries from 37 0/7 to 41 6/7 weeks of gestation from 2002 to 2008
finding: Neonatal morbidity was higher at 37 weeks compared with 39 weeks regardless of the precursor for delivery.
mod_finding: Respiratory morbidity was higher at 37 weeks than 39 weeks regardless of route of delivery.
